video_title: Kawhi talks incredible fan support, family loving Toronto, duplicating history with Raps

quotes.speaker: Kawhi Leonard
quotes.summary_phrase: Kawhi Leonard on why he chose the Toronto Raptors
quotes.excerpt: I didn't want to put on another organization jersey, and we did some great here.
quotes.quote: I thought I had good relationships with the front office. I enjoyed the city, the energy, the organization was cool. I met some people that I thought had good energy and good personalities and the relationship was still there. I didn't want to put on another organization jersey, and we did some great here. We did some great here and I wanted to make history happen again.

quotes.speaker: Kate Beirness
quotes.summary_phrase: Kate Beirness and OG Anunoby discuss the failed zoo trip
quotes.excerpt: We wanted to go to the zoo. It didn't happen.

text_blocks.speaker: Kate Beirness
text_blocks.text: We wanted to go to the zoo. It didn't happen.

text_blocks.speaker: OG Anunoby
text_blocks.text: Not my fault, it's your fault.

text_blocks.speaker: Kate Beirness
text_blocks.text: It's not my fault either, it's the PR fault.

quotes.speaker: Kawhi Leonard
quotes.summary_phrase: Kawhi Leonard on Alex McKechnie's ability to maximize player performance
quotes.excerpt: Alex McKechnie has been in the game for a long time, won several championships.
quotes.quote: Alex McKechnie has been in the game for a long time, won several championships for teams and I think he knows what to expect and how to get superstar players to reach their peak when the time matters in the playoffs and that's when you need to be your healthiest and feel the best and I think he knows how to do that.

quotes.speaker: Kawhi Leonard
quotes.summary_phrase: Kawhi Leonard on the defensive synergy with Scottie Barnes
quotes.excerpt: We're going to come out and play defense first, and defense leads to easy buckets.
quotes.quote: I think it meshes well because we're going to come out and play defense first, and defense leads to easy buckets on the offensive end. They're a fast-paced team, they get out in transition, I like to get out in transition, and I just want to win. I could play off different players, I think I'd be able to adjust my style easily.

quotes.speaker: Kawhi Leonard
quotes.summary_phrase: Kawhi Leonard on Kyle Lowry's work ethic and leadership
quotes.excerpt: Not too many people could put their jerseys in arena buildings and in the ceiling.
quotes.quote: It's great. It's hard work, his determination, his IQ, his smartness of the game, it's about the show. Not too many people could put their jerseys in arena buildings and in the ceiling, and he's going to be able to do that. It's just motivation for everybody, myself, the kids, just watching him only being six foot. You don't have to be the biggest guy, and you could be a 20-year point guard, win an NBA championship, play defense, lead the team, it's amazing.
